## PGLS Analysis of Barbet Traits
```{r}
library(ape)
library(nlme)
library(geiger)

# Import the barbet trait data
barbet_data <- read.csv(
  "~/Downloads/Barbetdata.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1
)

# Import the phylogenetic tree
barbet_tree <- read.nexus(
  "~/Downloads/BarbetTree.nex"
)

# Check the data and tree
dim(barbet_data)
length(barbet_tree$tip.label)
head(barbet_data)

# Check species matches
name_check <- geiger::name.check(barbet_tree, barbet_data)

# Count species that do not match
length(name_check$tree_not_data)
length(name_check$data_not_tree)

# Show matching species
intersect(barbet_tree$tip.label, rownames(barbet_data))
# Identify species present in both datasets
matching_species <- intersect(
  barbet_tree$tip.label,
  rownames(barbet_data)
)

# Remove species without trait data
matched_tree <- ape::keep.tip(
  barbet_tree,
  matching_species
)

# Arrange trait data in the same order as the tree
matched_data <- barbet_data[
  matched_tree$tip.label, ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Check the results
length(matched_tree$tip.label)
dim(matched_data)
# Examine wing and coloration measurements
summary(matched_data[, c("wing", "colour")])

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(matched_data[, c("wing", "colour")]))

# Check branch lengths
is.null(matched_tree$edge.length)
# Load packages
library(ape)
library(nlme)

# Add species names as a column
matched_data$Species <- rownames(matched_data)

# Create phylogenetic correlation structure
phylo_cor <- corBrownian(
  phy = matched_tree,
  form = ~ Species
)

# Run PGLS analysis
pgls_model <- gls(
  wing ~ colour,
  data = matched_data,
  correlation = phylo_cor,
  method = "ML"
)

# View results
summary(pgls_model)
summary(matched_data$colour)
sort(unique(matched_data$colour))
# Scatterplot of coloration and wing measurements
plot(
  matched_data$colour,
  matched_data$wing,
  main = "Coloration and Wing Measurements in Barbets",
  xlab = "Coloration Score",
  ylab = "Wing Measurement",
  pch = 19,
  col = "steelblue"
)
```
